headline: Xiaomi open-sources MiMo-V2.6 models after scaling reinforcement learning
headline_vi: Các mô hình MiMo-V2.6 mã nguồn mở của Xiaomi sau khi học tập tăng cường quy mô
summary: Xiaomi has released and open-sourced the MiMo-V2.6 series, including the native multimodal MiMo-V2.6-Pro and MiMo-V2.6-Flash models. Xiaomi also released MiMo-V2.6-Distill-Qwen-9B and research resources for reinforcement learning. MiMo-V2.6-Pro scored 46 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index
